_doc: Monsieur's subscriptions (declared by him), for information only: no routing effect (Monsieur, 2026-10-14). Shown on the library page with two sources only: our own measurement (meters + the tokens W.Alter's runtimes really used, priced at list API rates) and SemiAnalysis' published plan values. Readings go to models.subscription_usage.

semianalysis.report: Anthropic Subscriptions Offer 5x+ More Value Than OpenAI
semianalysis.definition: API-equivalent value = the plan's full monthly usage limit priced at first-party list API rates.

meter.note: Hermes agent/account_usage.py (Codex usage endpoint, read-only). Plus has a weekly window only.

excluded.claude-fable-5-1: not included in Pro (usage credits at API price)

meter.note: No Claude login on the VM: weekly meter estimated from the Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects). Units = input + cache writes + 5 x output, cache reads ~free (SemiAnalysis: no meter movement after 500M cache-read tokens). Rolling 7 days. Sessions run outside the VM are not seen.
meter.capacity_basis: prior from SemiAnalysis Pro / Opus 5.5 (1,178 $/month on their mix = 76.8 M cache writes + 11.8 M input + 8.9 M output per month = 30.7 M units/week). `walter-router subscriptions calibrate anthropic-pro <weekly %>` with the % shown on claude.ai replaces it.
